name: git-pilot
description: An extensible developer cockpit for GitLab (CE/EE) and GitHub. Phase 1: Issue <-> MR/PR status label sync.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Git Pilot sends your API tokens to the host from the repository remote and reads settings from the workspace, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Infer the platform from the git remote host.
Force GitLab (use for self-hosted GitLab instances).
Force GitHub (use for GitHub Enterprise Server).
gitPilot.provider.description: Which hosting platform the repository lives on.

gitPilot.instanceUrl.markdownDescription: Optional base URL override for self-hosted GitLab or GitHub Enterprise, e.g. `https://gitlab.company.com`. Leave empty to derive it from the `origin` remote.

gitPilot.branchIssueRegex.markdownDescription: Regular expression applied to the current branch name. The **first capturing group** must contain the Issue IID / number (e.g. `142-fix-auth`, `feat/142-login`).

gitPilot.allowInsecureHttp.markdownDescription: Allow sending API tokens over plain `http://` (e.g. an internal GitLab without TLS). **Not recommended:** anyone on the network path can read the token. Workspace settings cannot enable this.

gitPilot.statusSync.enabled.description: Enable the Status Sync module (Issue <-> MR/PR status label synchronization).

gitPilot.statusSync.labelPrefix.markdownDescription: Prefix identifying status labels. Use `status:` for regular labels or `status::` for GitLab Premium scoped labels. `:` and `::` variants are treated as equivalent when stripping old statuses.

enumDescriptions: The open MR/PR status silently overwrites the Issue status on divergence.
The Issue status silently overwrites open MR/PR statuses on divergence.
Highlight the conflict in the status bar and ask which status to apply.
gitPilot.statusSync.sourceOfTruth.description: Which side wins when the Issue and its MR/PR have different status labels.

gitPilot.statusSync.autoSyncInterval.description: Polling interval in seconds for automatic synchronization (0 disables polling).
